content: Tidepool production deploys to Railway from the main branch; the service is named tidepool-web.
Tidepool staging previews run on Vercel, one preview URL per pull request.
Tidepool uses pnpm 9 with a workspace; never run npm install in it, the lockfile is pnpm-lock.yaml.
Tidepool pins Node 20.11.1 in .nvmrc and in the engines field of package.json.
Run Tidepool unit tests with pnpm vitest run; Playwright end-to-end tests live under e2e/ and run with pnpm test:e2e.
The checkout Playwright spec flakes when the Stripe mock server on port 12111 starts after the dev server; start stripe-mock first.
Tidepool stores orders in Postgres hosted on Neon, accessed through Drizzle ORM.
Tidepool reads its database connection string from DATABASE_URL, and the pooled variant from DATABASE_URL_POOLED for serverless routes.
Tidepool API routes return errors as an error object with code and message fields, using snake_case codes like cart_not_found.
Tidepool CI on GitHub Actions misses the pnpm store cache unless the setup-node step comes after pnpm/action-setup.
Tidepool styles components with Tailwind CSS; no CSS modules in new code.
Product images for Tidepool are served from Cloudinary; the cloud name comes from NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD.
Unfinished: migrating the Tidepool cart from localStorage to a server session; the API half is done, but the hook in src/hooks/useCart.ts still reads localStorage.
next build for Tidepool runs out of heap on the 2 GB CI runner; setting NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 fixes it.
Tidepool authenticates shoppers with Auth.js magic links sent through Postmark.
The hydration mismatch warning on the product page comes from formatting prices with the server locale; format them on the client instead.
Tidepool uses Biome for linting and formatting instead of ESLint and Prettier.
Feature flags in Tidepool are read from the flags table at request time, not from env vars.
Unfinished: the Tidepool product search reindex job in scripts/reindex-meili.ts fails on items without a SKU; it needs a skip plus a log line.
Tidepool sends page analytics to a self-hosted Plausible instance.
Tidepool middleware cannot import the Drizzle client because middleware runs on the Edge runtime; query through an API route instead.
Tidepool branches are named feat/<ticket> or fix/<ticket>, with tickets from the TP Linear team.
Ledgerline production runs on Fly.io in the syd region with two machines.
Ledgerline staging deploys to Fly.io automatically when a tag matching v*-rc* is pushed.
Ledgerline builds with Go 1.23; the toolchain line in go.mod is go1.23.4.
Run Ledgerline tests with go test -race ./...; integration tests need the integration build tag and a running Postgres.
Ledgerline invoice tests flaked around midnight UTC because due dates used time.Now; they now take an injected clock from internal/clock.
Ledgerline uses Postgres 16 with migrations managed by goose in db/migrations.
Ledgerline reads its Postgres DSN from LEDGER_PG_DSN, not DATABASE_URL.
Ledgerline amounts are integer minor units (cents) in JSON, never floats, and currency is an ISO 4217 code.
Ledgerline returns error code LL-4091 when an idempotency key is reused with a different request body.
Ledgerline POST endpoints require an Idempotency-Key header; keys expire after 24 hours.
golangci-lint in Ledgerline CI times out at the default 1m; the config sets run.timeout to 5m.
Ledgerline charges cards through Adyen; the sandbox merchant account is LedgerlineTestECOM.
Ledgerline verifies Adyen webhooks with the HMAC key in ADYEN_HMAC_KEY.
Unfinished: Ledgerline mid-cycle plan change proration; the calculation in internal/billing/prorate.go is written but the downgrade credit path has no tests.
Ledgerline deadlocks under load came from locking invoices before subscriptions in one handler; always lock subscription rows first.
Ledgerline logs with log/slog in JSON format; request ids go in the req_id attribute.
Ledgerline API versions are in the path, /v1 and /v2; v1 is frozen and only receives security fixes.
Ledgerline local config lives in config/local.toml, which is gitignored; copy config/local.example.toml to start.
The Ledgerline Fly.io release command runs goose migrations; if a migration fails the deploy is aborted and machines stay on the old image.
Ledgerline traces are exported with OpenTelemetry to Honeycomb, dataset ledgerline-prod.
Unfinished: Ledgerline dunning email retries; the schedule is 1, 3 and 7 days but only the first email is wired up.
Ledgerline SQL queries are generated with sqlc; run make gen after editing db/queries/*.sql.
Quarry manages Python dependencies with uv; add packages with uv add, never pip install into the venv.
Quarry targets Python 3.12; 3.13 breaks the pinned pyarrow wheel.
Run Quarry tests with uv run pytest -m 'not slow'; the slow marker covers tests that download sample datasets.
Quarry pipelines are orchestrated with Dagster; asset definitions live in quarry/assets/.
Quarry's warehouse is DuckDB locally and MotherDuck in production.
Quarry's Dagster webserver and daemon deploy to Railway as two services sharing one Postgres for run storage.
Quarry test_fetch_rates flakes because it hits the live exchange rate API; it should use the recorded cassette in tests/cassettes/rates.yaml.
Quarry authenticates to MotherDuck with MOTHERDUCK_TOKEN; locally the variable is unset so DuckDB falls back to data/quarry.duckdb.
Quarry code is formatted with ruff format at line length 100 and type checked with mypy --strict.
Quarry's nightly ingest schedule runs at 02:30 Pacific/Auckland time.
Quarry's invoice export OOMs with pandas on the full year; the Polars lazy version streams it in under 2 GB.
Quarry reads raw vendor files from the S3 bucket quarry-raw-landing in ap-southeast-2.
Quarry exit code 75 means a source was temporarily unavailable and Dagster should retry, not alert.
Unfinished: moving Quarry transforms from raw SQL files to dbt; staging models are ported, the marts in sql/marts/ are not.
Quarry CI fails with 'IO Error: Could not set lock on file' when two jobs share the DuckDB file; each job needs its own temp database path.
Quarry column names are snake_case and timestamps are stored as UTC with an _at suffix.
Quarry secrets are pulled from Doppler at run time with doppler run; no .env files in the repo.
Quarry failure alerts go to the #data-alerts Slack channel through a Dagster sensor.
Quarry's source registry is config/sources.yaml; each entry needs an owner and a freshness SLA in hours.
Quarry daily partitions shifted by a day because Dagster used UTC; the partition definition now sets timezone Pacific/Auckland.
Quarry keeps raw landing files for 90 days, then an S3 lifecycle rule moves them to Glacier.
Exploratory Quarry notebooks go in notebooks/ and are stripped of outputs by nbstripout in a pre-commit hook.
Fernweh uses Yarn 4 (Berry) with the node-modules linker because Metro does not support Plug'n'Play.
Fernweh is on Expo SDK 51 with React Native 0.74.
Fernweh app binaries are built with EAS Build; the production profile is in eas.json.
Run Fernweh tests with yarn jest; Detox end-to-end tests run only on the macOS runner with yarn e2e:ios.
Fernweh Detox tests flake on the iOS simulator when animations are on; the test build sets EXPO_PUBLIC_DISABLE_ANIMATIONS=1.
Fernweh talks to a Supabase backend for auth, trips and photos.
Fernweh reads the Supabase URL and anon key from EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
Fernweh ships JavaScript-only fixes as EAS Update over-the-air updates on the production channel; native changes need a store build.
Fernweh Android builds fail with 'Duplicate class kotlin.collections.jdk8' after adding the maps library; forcing kotlin-stdlib 1.9.24 in android/build.gradle fixes it.
Fernweh state management uses Zustand stores in src/stores; no Redux.
Fernweh navigation uses Expo Router with file-based routes under app/.
Fernweh supports English, German and Japanese; translation strings live in locales/*.json and are managed in Tolgee.
Unfinished: Fernweh offline map tiles; downloading works, but the cache eviction in src/maps/tileCache.ts never deletes old regions.
Fernweh App Store review rejected the build because NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription was vague; the string must say why background location is needed.
Fernweh crash reports go to Sentry; source maps are uploaded by the EAS post-build hook.
Fernweh supports iOS 15 and Android API level 26 as minimums.
Fernweh crashes on launch with 'Property Intl is not defined' on older Android because Hermes lacks Intl.DateTimeFormat there; the polyfill is imported in app/_layout.tsx.
Fernweh reads Supabase tables directly, but all writes go through Postgres RPC functions prefixed with fw_.
Fernweh colors and spacing come from src/theme/tokens.ts; don't hardcode hex values in components.
Fernweh internal testers get staging builds through TestFlight and the Play Console internal track.
Unfinished: Fernweh trip reminder push notifications; Expo push tokens are saved but the scheduling edge function is not deployed.
When Fernweh shows stale code after switching branches, clear the Metro cache with npx expo start -c.
Brasswind's minimum supported Rust version is 1.79, declared as rust-version in Cargo.toml.
Run Brasswind tests with cargo nextest run; doctests still need cargo test --doc separately.
Brasswind snapshot tests flaked in parallel because they shared a fixed temp directory; each test now creates its own with tempfile::tempdir.
Brasswind releases are built by cargo-dist for Linux, macOS and Windows and published to GitHub Releases.
Brasswind is distributed through a Homebrew tap named brasswind-labs/tap and on crates.io.
Brasswind uses anyhow in the binary crate and thiserror in the library crate.
Brasswind parses arguments with clap 4 derive macros.
Brasswind reads user config from ~/.config/brasswind/config.toml, overridden by BRASSWIND_CONFIG.
Brasswind exits with status 3 when the lockfile is out of date, so scripts can tell it apart from a general failure (1).
Brasswind Windows CI failed on path tests because of backslashes; tests compare paths with dunce::canonicalize instead of strings.
Brasswind CI runs cargo clippy with -D warnings and cargo fmt --check; pedantic lints are off.
Brasswind directory scanning got 4x faster after switching from walkdir to the ignore crate with parallel walking.
Unfinished: Brasswind shell completions; bash and zsh are generated in build.rs, fish and PowerShell are not.
Brasswind audits dependencies with cargo-deny; licenses must be MIT, Apache-2.0 or BSD.
Brasswind honours NO_COLOR and its own BRASSWIND_COLOR=always|never|auto.
Brasswind musl release builds failed linking openssl; switching reqwest to the rustls-tls feature removed the OpenSSL dependency.
Brasswind avoids async entirely; HTTP calls use ureq, blocking.
The brasswind.lock file format is versioned by a top-level schema = 2 line; bump it when fields change.
Brasswind panicked with 'byte index is not a char boundary' when truncating non-ASCII package names; truncation now uses char_indices.
Brasswind user docs are an mdBook in docs/book, deployed to GitHub Pages on each release.
Unfinished: Brasswind WASM plugin API; the wasmtime host bindings compile but the plugin manifest schema is undecided.
Brasswind benchmarks use criterion in benches/; compare against the saved main baseline before merging performance changes.
Oriel runs Elixir 1.17 on Erlang/OTP 27, pinned in .tool-versions for asdf.
Oriel staging deploys to Fly.io in the lhr region, app name oriel-staging.
Oriel production runs on Render as a Docker service with a managed Postgres.
Run Oriel tests with mix test; browser tests use Wallaby and need chromedriver on PATH.
Oriel LiveView tests flake with DBConnection.OwnershipError when a spawned Task touches the repo; allow the task pid in the Ecto sandbox.
Oriel uses Postgres 15 through Ecto; migrations are in priv/repo/migrations.
Oriel reads its Phoenix signing secret from SECRET_KEY_BASE and the database from ORIEL_DATABASE_URL.
Oriel staff sign in with Google Workspace SSO via ueberauth_google; only the oriel-ops.test domain is allowed.
Oriel background jobs run with Oban; queues are default, mailers and exports with limits 10, 5 and 2.
Oriel export jobs got discarded after 20 attempts during an S3 outage; max_attempts for the exports queue is now 5 with exponential backoff.
Oriel UI is Phoenix LiveView with Tailwind and the core_components.ex function components; no React.
Oriel CI runs mix format --check-formatted and mix credo --strict.
Unfinished: Oriel audit log for admin actions; the audit_events table exists but only user deletions write to it.
Oriel migrations run from the release with bin/oriel eval 'Oriel.Release.migrate()' as Render's pre-deploy command.
Oriel's internal JSON API uses JSON:API style with a data envelope and kebab-case attribute names.
Oriel returns HTTP 423 with code ORL-LOCKED when another admin is editing the same record.
Oriel nodes on Fly.io did not cluster until DNS_CLUSTER_QUERY was set to oriel-staging.internal.
Oriel authorisation rules live in lib/oriel/policy.ex using the Bodyguard behaviour.
Unfinished: Oriel CSV export for the customers table times out above 50k rows; the plan is to stream it through an Oban job and email a link.
Oriel LiveView processes held large assigns for the reports page; using streams for the table rows cut memory per connection by about 80 percent.
Oriel sends email with Swoosh through the Postmark adapter.
Oriel feature flags use FunWithFlags backed by Postgres, toggled from /admin/flags.
The developer uses Neovim with LazyVim; suggest editor tips for Neovim, not VS Code.
Prefer two-space indentation in JavaScript, TypeScript, YAML and Elixir; tabs only where gofmt demands them.
Commit messages follow Conventional Commits, with a lowercase imperative subject under 72 characters.
Keep explanations short; show the command or diff first, then one line of reasoning.
The developer's shell is fish, so avoid bash-only syntax like export VAR=value in suggested commands.
Always rebase feature branches onto main instead of merging main into them.
Write a failing test before fixing a bug whenever the bug is reproducible.
On the developer's ARM laptop, Docker images without a linux/arm64 variant run under emulation and are very slow; build multi-arch images.
Ask before adding a new third-party dependency to any project.
Use descriptive variable names; no single-letter names outside short loops.
Code comments should explain why, not what; don't narrate obvious code.
Personal secrets and API tokens live in 1Password; retrieve them with the op CLI rather than pasting them into files.
Keep pull requests under about 400 changed lines; split larger work into stacked PRs.
The developer uses the Catppuccin Mocha theme in the terminal and editor.
Pre-commit hooks across projects are managed with lefthook, installed with lefthook install after cloning.
The developer works in the Pacific/Auckland time zone; schedule reminders in NZ time.
Batch dependency updates weekly through Renovate; don't bump versions ad hoc in feature PRs.
Unfinished: moving dotfiles to chezmoi; fish and Neovim configs are migrated, git config is not.
